environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed in the 'documents' namespace on an Istio 1.20 mesh cluster. The mesh-wide PeerAuthentication enforces STRICT mTLS. An AuthorizationPolicy named 'deny-cross-ns-upload' is applied in the 'documents' namespace with spec.action DENY, matching source.notNamespaces ['documents','istio-system'] on paths ['/api/documentupload/upload']. A second AuthorizationPolicy 'allow-internal-only' with spec.action ALLOW requires source.principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/api-gateway/sa/gateway-sa'. The ingress VirtualService routes only through the api-gateway namespace's envoy proxy which applies a custom EnvoyFilter that strips requests with Content-Disposition headers containing extensions matching (.aspx|.asp|.jsp|.php|.exe|.dll|.sh|.bat|.cmd|.ps1|.html|.htm|.svg|.shtml). The api-gateway service account 'gateway-sa' has an additional RBAC policy limiting request body size to 10MB for this route.
